Check visible UI text for generated secrets and absolute host paths before writing public images. Actual GUI review/completion screenshots contain private paths: retain them privately, publish only hashes. Independently hash-check and manually view public images. A 0600 mode alone is not a Windows ACL guarantee. Reports remain verified24h:false and make no physical-phone/Safari/other-OS model-quality claim.
